description: New keyword ideas for one app in one storefront, written in that storefront's search language: terms of 1–3 words people type into the store search box, each with a one-line reason naming who searches it and why the app answers that need. Tracked keywords, keywords you buried and brand names stay out. Uses one AI writing credit from the monthly allowance (Pro and above); measure the ideas with get_keyword_metrics before you track them.

cc.description: storefront code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: suggest_keywords
